{{< include _scripts.qmd >}}

Eric Rasmussen (Early Childhood Music, Peabody Preparatory at Johns Hopkins; a student of Edwin Gordon) and the guitarist and teacher Beau
Taillefer make [Audiation in the Wild](https://audiation-in-the-wild.simplecast.com), 108 episodes from 2022. Rasmussen's own site is
[teachmusictokids.com](https://teachmusictokids.com). These pages link to every episode with the site's own summary; the episodes are heard at
the show. A summary here comes from the episode's show notes and its title, **not the audio**, and each step says which; many notes are
only the hosts' contact lines, so those are "Title only". No episode has a published transcript, and each step says so. Songs and pieces
the notes name are in the [Tune Directory](../practice/tune-directory.qmd). Related: [Shouldice](shouldice.qmd), [Bluestine](bluestine.qmd).
